language.script: Ge'ez script (Amharic); Afaan Oromo uses Latin/Qubee — two scripts coexist in one country

terrainDescription.zh: 衣索比亞高原為主，地形崎嶇多山，在撒哈拉以南非洲中較特殊
terrainDescription.en: Dominated by the Ethiopian Highlands — rugged and mountainous, unusual among Sub-Saharan countries

plate.color: Historically region-coded plates (11+ regional abbreviations); transitioning to a unified national format under the "ETH" distinguishing code — exact background/text color not confirmed by sources found

utilityPole.transformerMount: No Ethiopia-specific source found for pole/transformer style — flagging as unconfirmed rather than guessing detail

historicalContext.zh: 衣索比亞是非洲少數未被歐洲殖民的國家，保有獨特曆法與正教會傳統。
historicalContext.en: One of the few African countries never colonized by a European power, retaining its own calendar and Orthodox Christian traditions.

note.zh: 傳統服飾 Habesha Kemis（白棉布搭配彩色織邊）常見於節慶與教堂場合，日常街景中年輕人多穿西式服裝；正教會十字架與蜂窩狀雕刻教堂建築反而是較穩定可見的文化線索。
note.en: Traditional Habesha Kemis (white cotton with colorful woven borders) appears mainly at festivals/churches — everyday streetwear tends Western-style. Orthodox church architecture (domes, honeycomb carving) is a more consistently visible cultural clue.

culturalMarkers.caveat: Clothing is festival-only; architecture is the steadier signal
